title: Sami Potta Mudichu
desc: Kadhirvelan wishes to take revenge on his uncle, who is responsible for his grandfather's death. However, he changes his mind after he meets Neelaveni, his uncle's daughter.

title: Thirumanam Enum Nikkah
desc: Raghav and Priya pretend to be Muslim on a train journey. They fall in love, but their relationship is tested when true identities emerge.

title: Parijatham
desc: Surendhar's mother tells him that she has found him a bride. Before the couple can meet, his mother dies in an accident. He sets out to find the woman his mother wanted him to marry.
